question.text: What percentage of companies globally will fulfill their pre-2026 cage-free commitments in 2026 and 2027?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the percentage of global companies reporting in 2026 or 2027 that they have fulfilled the cage-free commitments they made before 2026 according to [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker) when accessed by Metaculus on January 1, 2028.
question.fine_print:
Specifically, the denominator will be obtained by selecting the "Cage-Free" issue on the [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free) progress tracker, a "Victory Date" of 1990 to 2025, and a "Timeline" of 2026 and after. The numerator will then be obtained by *additionally* selecting the "Reporting Fulfilled" status.

If Chicken Watch ceases reporting or significantly changes its criteria such that previous reporting is not comparable, this question will be **annulled**.

research:
I could not get a current figure for this exact query. The Chicken Watch tracker loads its data in the browser through Awesome Table (view ID `-NqYH6wXir1Ia4I27P6G`, backed by Firebase), and I found no public CSV or JSON file behind it. So I can't report the live numerator or denominator for the "Victory Date 1990-2025, Timeline 2026 and after" filter, with or without "Reporting Fulfilled". No source I searched publishes a fulfilment rate for commitments with deadlines in 2026 or later.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-19: The tracker page loads but shows only a loading spinner until the browser runs its scripts. The Awesome Table view itself was readable but contained no data. [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free)
- 2026-11-19: Chicken Watch's cage-free page says "over 1000 leading companies" have pledged and gives no fulfilment rates. [Chicken Watch cage-free](https://chickenwatch.org/cage-free)
- The Metaculus range (3.56% to 30.19%) hints that the question author expected a value in the low tens, but that is my inference only.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The numerator counts commitments marked "Reporting Fulfilled" when Metaculus checks on 2028-01-01, so companies that fulfil early, or fulfil in 2026-2027, add to it.
- The denominator is commitments with deadlines in 2026 or later. Many of those are 2027-2030 pledges, plus longer Asian timelines up to around 2032, and many will not be due by January 2028. That should keep the share low. This is a structural point, not data.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-29: The Open Wing Alliance's Fair and Fowl 2026 report found that 118 of 171 global companies assessed had fulfilled their commitments or were making progress. More than 2,800 companies have made cage-free pledges. Caffè Nero met its 2026 deadline early, The Cheesecake Factory finished six years ahead of its deadline, and some companies have removed their timelines or stopped reporting. [EIN Presswire](https://www.einpresswire.com/article/944933228/fair-and-fowl-2026-finds-cage-free-sourcing-is-now-standard-practice-as-corporate-holdouts-dwindle)
- 2026-08: The Humane League's first US food manufacturer report named Land O'Lakes and Flowers Foods for walking back their pledges. [PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/as-cage-free-egg-supply-peaks-new-report-highlights-manufacturers-risking-brand-trust-302853686.html)
- 2026-05-12: The Humane League's 2026 Eggsposé repeated that 92% of commitments due in 2024 or earlier have been fulfilled. Four foodservice firms (AVI, Guest Services, Genuine Foods, Southern Foodservice) dropped their cage-free policies entirely. [PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/the-humane-leagues-new-2026-eggspose-reveals-foodservice-providers-failing-to-deliver-on-cage-free-commitments-and-recognizes-industry-leaders-302769084.html)
- 2026-03-25: Faunalytics, citing Chicken Watch data as of 2026-02-02, reported that 64% of global cage-free commitments due in 2025 or earlier were fulfilled, against 93% for 2024 deadlines. By region: Europe 70%, Asia 58%, Africa 62%, Latin America 50%. More than 1,000 commitments were due in 2025. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
- 2026-02: Lagardère Travel Retail reported 100% cage-free sourcing worldwide. [NatLawReview](https://natlawreview.com/press-releases/open-wing-alliance-applauds-lagardere-travel-retails-100-cage-free-egg)
- 2026-01: The Chick-fil-A case was covered as a possible missed deadline or retreat on its pledge. [Feedstuffs](https://www.feedstuffs.com/agribusiness-news/chick-fil-a-may-miss-cage-free-egg-deadline)

## 4. Base rates
- Fulfilment rates for commitments that are already due:
  - 2024-05: 89% of those due in 2023 or earlier. [Food Industry Executive](https://foodindustryexecutive.com/2024/05/new-data-shows-89-of-cage-free-egg-commitments-are-fulfilled-by-food-corporations/)
  - 2025-07: 92% of those due in 2024 or earlier. [Food Processing](https://www.foodprocessing.com/ingredients/dairy-cheese-eggs/news/55307812/92-of-global-cage-free-egg-commitments-fulfilled)
  - 2026-02: 64% of those due in 2025 or earlier. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
- Fulfilment tends to come late. Reporting on a deadline year builds up over the following 1 to 2 years, which is why the 2025-or-earlier figure is lower.
- For comparison, only 6% of Better Chicken Commitments due in 2025 or earlier were fulfilled, and 2026 is the most common deadline year for those (more than 350 commitments). [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
- I found no past values for this exact filter, so I can't give a trend or typical variation for it.
- Seasonality: none in any physical sense. Updates cluster around NGO report cycles (Rotten Eggs in January, Eggsposé in May, the Open Wing Alliance fulfilment report in July or August, Fair and Fowl in September or October) and around companies' annual ESG reports, which mostly come out in the first half of the year.

## 5. Other forecasts
- No Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market matches this question. On Kalshi, "Cage-Free" being mentioned on Cal-Maine's 2027-01-06 earnings call trades at 0.80. That is unrelated to the resolution value.
- I found no Metaculus community forecast or expert estimate.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- January 2027: likely a 2027 Rotten Eggs report on missed 2026 deadlines.
- Spring 2027: corporate ESG reports for 2026, the main way Chicken Watch learns of fulfilment.
- May 2027: likely a Humane League Eggsposé.
- Mid-2027: likely an Open Wing Alliance fulfilment progress report.
- Around September 2027: likely Fair and Fowl 2027.
- 2027-06-30: forecasts close.
- Ongoing: bird flu supply shocks and cage-free price premiums, plus US policy rollbacks (pledges withdrawn, as with Chick-fil-A and the foodservice firms above), could slow fulfilment. Chicken Watch's coding of "Reporting Fulfilled" and how often it updates the database are also unknowns.
- 2028-01-01: resolution.

The forecaster should apply these filters in a browser.
- How the metric works: it is a snapshot of the tracker on 2028-01-01. The denominator is every pre-2026 commitment with a deadline of 2026 or later, which includes deadlines out to the 2030s. Commitments that get fulfilled, removed or re-dated by then change the result.
- Metaculus set the range at 3.56%-30.19%. That suggests the starting value was in the low teens or below, but I could not confirm the value when the question was created.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The share can only rise if 2026 and 2027 commitments are reported as fulfilled faster than new pre-2026 commitments with later deadlines are added. Very few commitments made before 2026 should still be getting added.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11 (exact date not confirmed): A report on Asia found that 57 of 95 multinational food and hospitality companies (60%) do not disclose verifiable cage-free progress in Asia. This matters because many global commitments have Asia components due 2025-2030. ([EIN Presswire](https://www.einnews.com/pr_news/957453575/global-food-brands-face-scrutiny-over-asian-cage-free-egg-sourcing-as-report-exposes-esg-double-standards); the page returned 403, so this comes from search snippets)
- 2026 (date not confirmed): Fair and Fowl 2026 (Open Wing Alliance / THL) reportedly says 118 of 171 global companies evaluated have either fulfilled their cage-free commitments or are making positive progress. I could not open the press release. ([EIN Presswire](https://www.einnews.com/pr_news/944933228/fair-and-fowl-2026-finds-cage-free-sourcing-is-now-standard-practice-as-corporate-holdouts-dwindle))

It projects half of US hens will be cage-free by 2027. ([THL](https://thehumaneleague.org/article/2026-cage-free-eggspose-manufacturers))
- 2026-04-08: Chick-fil-A said meeting its 2026 cage-free goal is "uncertain," citing bird flu. This is a 2026 deadline that is likely to be missed or re-dated. ([Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/food-drink/chick-fil-a-retreats-decade-old-egg-pledge-bird-flu-hits-supply))
- 2026 Q1: Bird flu led to the culling of 15.2 million table-egg layers in five states, according to USDA as cited in search results. ([Feedstuffs](https://www.feedstuffs.com/agribusiness-news/chick-fil-a-may-miss-cage-free-egg-deadline))
- 2026-11-19: A Kalshi market prices "Cage-Free" being mentioned on Cal-Maine's 2027-01-06 earnings call at 0.80. This is related only indirectly.

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-02: Chicken Watch data cited by Faunalytics: 64% of global cage-free commitments with deadlines of 2025 or earlier are fulfilled, against 93% of 2024-deadline commitments. More than 1,000 commitments (about 40% of all) were due in 2025. ([Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/))
- 2025: Fair and Fowl 2025: 92% of commitments with deadlines of 2024 or earlier are fulfilled. ([THL](https://thehumaneleague.org/article/fair-and-fowl-2025))
- 2024-05: Open Wing Alliance: 89% of commitments due 2023 or earlier are fulfilled. ([Food Industry Executive](https://foodindustryexecutive.com/2024/05/new-data-shows-89-of-cage-free-egg-commitments-are-fulfilled-by-food-corporations/))
- Regional rates for deadlines of 2025 or earlier: Europe 70%, Africa 62%, Asia 58%, Latin America 50% ([Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)).
- What this means for the question: fulfillment among commitments not yet due is much lower than among those already due. Companies usually report fulfillment around or after the deadline, and reporting lags. The share of 2026+ commitments marked fulfilled should rise mainly as 2026 and 2027 deadlines pass and companies report, usually in sustainability reports in the first half of each year. I could not find a time series for this exact filter.
- Seasonality: reporting is concentrated in annual and ESG report cycles (roughly March-July) and in Open Wing Alliance and Chicken Watch data updates. I could not find earlier yearly values for this filter.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not find a Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this question. The Kalshi markets supplied with the brief (Cal-Maine, egg prices) do not match it.
- Founders Pledge, as cited by Rethink Priorities, estimated a 60% probability that companies follow through on cage-free commitments. This is an old estimate. ([Rethink Priorities](https://rethinkpriorities.org/research-area/will-companies-meet-their-animal-welfare-commitments/))
- Related Metaculus question: about 45.43% of US hens were cage-free in June 2025 ([Metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/3344)).

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution

- Annulment risk: if Chicken Watch changes its tracker or migrates platforms (the site is already on a new Next.js build), the question is annulled.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) Time left: about 13.5 months. Chicken Watch is read on 2028-01-01, and forecasts close 2027-06-30.

(b) Latest known value: there is no live reading. The question bounds work out exactly to 12/323 (3.715%) and 97/323 (30.03%). That suggests that when the question was written (around 2025 or early 2026), 12 of 323 commitments with a 2026-or-later timeline were marked "Reporting Fulfilled", about 3.7%. This is an inference from the bounds, not a confirmed reading.

(c) If nothing changed: about 3.7 to 5%.

(d) If the current trend continued: Reported fulfilment tends to cluster around and just after each deadline.
- For deadlines due in 2025 or earlier, the rate fell from 92% to 64% once more than 1,000 commitments due in 2025 came into scope. That implies roughly 35 to 45% of 2025 deadlines were marked fulfilled within about a month of the deadline.
- I assume the 2026-and-later set is roughly 25% due in 2026, 15% in 2027, and 60% in 2028-2030 or later, with Asia and Latin America heavily represented and lower rates there.
- Assumed fulfilment by January 2028: about 50% for 2026 deadlines, 25% for 2027, and about 8% for later ones.
- That gives roughly 18 to 21%. Allowing for reporting lag and for data updates mostly tied to the annual Open Wing Alliance cycle, my median is about 13 to 15%.

(e) Historical variation: the headline fulfilment rates moved by around 30 points in a single year when the deadline mix changed. For this filter, moving from about 4% to anything between 6% and 30% over two years is plausible.

(f) Experts and markets: no markets or forecasts exist. The question creator's upper bound of about 30% suggests they expected a low-to-mid-teens value.

(g) Scenarios:
- Low: Chicken Watch updates its database rarely, or new commitments with long timelines are added to the denominator, and pledges are rolled back. The value stays around 4 to 6%.
- High: many of the 323 have 2026 deadlines, possibly Europe-heavy, and large multinationals report global completion in their 2027 ESG reports. A thorough Open Wing Alliance data refresh in mid-2027 pushes the value to 30 to 38%.

(a) **Time left:** About 13.5 months. Resolution uses the tracker as accessed on 2028-01-01. Forecasts close 2027-06-30.

(b) **Latest known value:** No live reading was available. The question's bounds look like simple fractions of 323: the minimum 3.715% equals 12/323 and the soft maximum 30.03% equals 97/323. That suggests that when the question was created (around late 2025 or early 2026), 12 of 323 commitments with 2026+ timelines were marked "Reporting Fulfilled", about 3.7%. This is an inference from the bounds, not a reported figure.

(c) **If nothing changed:** About 3.7%. In practice it has probably already risen somewhat during 2026 from early or on-time fulfilments of 2026 deadlines, perhaps to around 6-10%.

(d) **If the current trend continued:**
- **How the share should build up:** The denominator is roughly fixed (victory dates up to 2025). By January 2028:
  - 2026-deadline commitments will have had about a year of reporting.
  - 2027-deadline ones will have had only a few months.
- **How fast past cohorts were reported fulfilled:**
  - Commitments due 2023 or earlier reached 89% by May 2024.
  - Commitments due 2025 or earlier were at 64% by February 2026, so the 2025-only cohort was probably around 45-55% shortly after its deadline.
- **Projection:** Suppose 2026 deadlines make up about 35-45% of the denominator and reach about 50-60% fulfilled. Add a few points from 2027 deadlines and early fulfilment of later ones. That gives roughly 18-26%.
- **Discount:** I lower this for several reasons:
  - 2026+ pledges skew toward harder regions (Asia, Latin America) and toward global pledges.
  - Some pledges are being withdrawn.
  - Companies that push back missed 2025 deadlines could enter the denominator and dilute the share.
  - Chicken Watch's data entry may lag.
- **Central estimate:** About 16-18%.

(e) **Historical variation:** I have no history for this exact filter. Cohort fulfilment rates have moved by tens of points within a year after a deadline (for example, 64% versus about 90% for adjacent cohorts), so a one-year horizon allows large moves.

(f) **Experts and markets:** There is no market. The creator's range (3.7-30%) implies they expected low-to-mid tens. NGO reports describe cage-free as "standard practice", but also note backsliding.

(g) **Unexpected outcomes:**
- **Low:** Chicken Watch barely updates statuses, or many companies extend 2025 pledges to 2026+ and inflate the denominator, while bird flu and US rollbacks stall fulfilment. The share stays around 5-8%.
- **High:** Most of the denominator turns out to be 2026 deadlines, and big global firms report full fulfilment in spring 2027 ESG reports. The share exceeds 30%.
